_note: Website-only settings. Items, prices, photos and stock live in Square (Square Dashboard > Items). This file says which Square categories appear on the website and in what order, plus a few things Square doesn't hold.

christmas._how: Christmas pre-orders. List the Square item names that are Christmas-only under items, and the pickup/delivery days as YYYY-MM-DD under dates, e.g. ["2026-12-20", "2026-12-23"]. While dates is empty, these items sell like any other flowers. Once dates are set, customers ordering them must choose one of those days at checkout. orderAheadDays is how many days before a day it stops taking orders (1 = order by the day before).

focus._how: Photo focus spots, by Square item name, as "across% down%" (50% 50% is the centre). The site keeps this spot in view however it crops the photo. Pick them by clicking the photo at /focus.html, then copy the line it gives you into here.
